scope: S3 safe views and existing browser regression

tests.name: S3 encrypted PDF becomes PNG and alternate text; browser never receives the original
S3 Sheets actual output renders saved values without formulas or active links
S3 immutable selected version, current participant access and shared page authorization
S3 original and artifact revocation reject manifest/image and clear an open browser view
S3 missing artifact secret, invalid AAD and viewer outage fail closed without original fallback
S3 current AV outage denies every new view and page request
S3 artifact key rotation retains old viewing and grants only artifact key material to viewer
S3 share revoke removes open pages/text and denies subsequent image and manifest requests
S3 old original and invoice PDF endpoints return empty 410 to every actor and anonymous user
S3 fixed XLSX type date merge hidden and stale-cache expectations from S0 remain true
S3 unrepresentable XLSX refs types merges and quotas never become ready or truncated views
S3 Japanese twenty-page order and image-only text alternative, geometry never silently downscaled
S3 session expiry removes already open text and image

secrets_policy: No trace, video, storageState, network dump or failure screenshot. Diagnostics redact credentials and URLs.
